purpose: Teach: 身勝手/行き届い/正気/脱帽/つまっ/のぞく/使いこなす/築き上げ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、身勝手すぎる事はないか?
lines.en: Riku — aren't you being a little selfish here?
lines.style: Testing challenge delivered with underlying care. Sharp edge softened by a glance. Not quite accusation, more like a dare to explain himself. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前ん家、片付けが行き届いてるな、桜
lines.en: Your place is pretty neat, isn't it? That's — that's kind of impressive, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine compliment with a stumble underneath. Not used to saying nice things. Slight hesitation before the second try, like he's correcting course mid-thought. Warm but awkward.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、正気で部活辞めるんだろ?
lines.en: Wait — you're actually serious about quitting club? Like, for real?
lines.style: Genuine surprise breaking through. Leans back slightly like she's reassessing. Quick, sharp tone but not unkind. Testing whether he means it or if this is a bluff.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の発想力には脱帽だ、桜
lines.en: I have to admit — the way you think is kind of different. In a good way.
lines.style: Quieter this time. Less defending, more offering something true. The kind of compliment he doesn't know how to take. Steady eye contact, no escape route.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のバッグ、教科書でつまってるな
lines.en: Your backpack's stuffed with textbooks again. Pretty on-brand for you.
lines.style: Dry observation with a hint of affection underneath. Light, almost teasing tone. Not criticizing — just noticing. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、トイレをのぞくとか冗談やめろよ、桜
lines.en: And stop with the stupid jokes about checking on me in the bathroom — seriously.
lines.style: Mock-exasperated but genuinely flustered. The embarrassment is real. Covers it with firmness. A line delivered while avoiding her eyes, then glancing back to see if she got it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、スマホを完全に使いこなすな
lines.en: You've actually got your phone totally figured out, don't you?
lines.style: Observation wrapped in teasing. Light tone, no real bite. She's noticing something small about him and letting him know she pays attention. Playful, not mocking.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、コツコツ友達を築き上げてきたな、桜
lines.en: You know, you've built up your friendships pretty steadily. That takes something.
lines.style: Sincere admiration underneath a quieter delivery. Slower pace. Like he's piecing something together as he speaks. Respect, not pity. A real acknowledgment of something he's watched her do.
